strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: neno keybox ma tye i kare ni i kom Google's revocation list (CRL) ki temo jami mapol nio ka onongo keybox ma tye kakare, ki gwoko ne kene ki cako tic pa Google. Tiiyo i kom gin mo kiken ki mito intanet (dakika 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox ki i network: kwanyo keybox ki i ka gwoko jami (GitHub) ki gwoko ne i /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. mito intanet ki tero dakika 1-3. Ki tiiyo kwede ka jami ma ki lwongo ni smart fetch ni obale onyo ka keybox ni ki loko ki cing.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: neno jami ma tye ma ki lwongo ni Remote Key Provisioning modules, neno TEE attestation certificate version, ki nyutu kit ma KmInstallKeybox tool tye kwede. Pe loko gin mo keken — neno kit ma jami ni tye kwede.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine nen (kwano keken): nyutu Widevine lanyut ma nyutu rwom (L1/L3) ki i dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-file ma tye, ki jami ma rwate ki jami ma ki tiyo kwede. Pe loko gin mo keken.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Ki yubu peko me moko ni jami ma ki moko ni otiime oyoto. Ngwec acel acel nyutu rwom me loc/rweny ma nen maber.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. Tiimo jami ma tek ki tero kare malac. Adwogi ma nen maber nen i agiki.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: kwanyo Play Store ki Google tic (GMS+GSF) ki dwoko jami ni odoco. Pi moko lok ma tek keken — pe gudu cal ni onyo karatac ni.
strings.mdCertify: • Cik me tuku: neno RKP rwom me moko ni jami ni ki dwoko rwom me moko ne ka mitte. Pe gudu ngec pa latic.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER yubu: yubu Google yub me tic (SOTER) peko ma mako moko jami ma ki tiyo kwede. Ki tiiyo kwede pi jami mogo ma jenge i kom SOTER ma ka Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Tic ki PIF: tiyo ki teko /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh. Tii ki lanyut ma ki yero (local/advanced) ki medo pif.prop/pif.json files. Adwogi ma nen maber nen i lok ma ki coyo ni.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF neno: nyutu kit ma injin ni tye kwede, jami ma ki keto i cing (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), ki lok ma ki coyo. Nen keken — pe loko gin mo keken.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Kwanyo gin manyen ma ki cwalo i Canary Engine me neno ni rwate ki cik ma miite RKP (Dwe me aryo mwaka 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Temo gin ma ki lwongo ni Engine: neno kit ma TrickyStoreOSS tye kwede (pid, logs), gin ma ki keto i keybox (ma tye ka tic ki ngat ma tiyo kwede), gin ma tye ada onyo ma pi adaa, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Nyutu me neno two keken.
strings.btnKbSlotsStatus: 🔍 Kit ma kabedo ni tye kwede
strings.btnKbSlotsPromote: ⬆️ Medo rwom me aryo → rwom me acel
strings.hintKbSlots: Gin ma ki lwongo ni module ni tye ka gwoko kabedo aryo: ma pire tek (ma ki gwoko, ma pe ki kwanyo) ki ma me aryo (ma ki gwoko). Tab man nyutu kabedo mene ma tye ka tic, loko gin ma imito, onyo medo gin me aryo me doko gin ma pire tek ka ki penyo — ki gwoko ki lok ma opong.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Integrity diagnosis: temo TEE key import, library injection inside keystore2, revocation status (CRL), protection-list coverage ki RKP state. Kwan keken — pe loko gin mo keken.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
🔧 Safe re-apply:

• Gin ma ki lwongo ni protection list ni ki dwoko cen ki i app weny ma ki keto.
• The custom-ROM compatibility layer is re-applied.
• The active keybox is re-applied.
#000#00#services is ki cako odoco.

Pe tye gin mo ma ki kwanyo ki gin ma ki keto i kom gin ma pire tek pe ki gudu.

Mede anyim?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slots: nyutu kit ma primary ki secondary slots tye kwede ki loko gin ma imito i kin gi. Gin ma pire tek (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) kare weny ki gwoko ki pe ki rucu ne. Medo gin me aryo me doko gin ma pire tek mito ni ki moko ne.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Medo rwom me aryo me doko gin ma pire tek:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml doko gin ma pire tek.
• Gin ma pire tek ma tye ni ki gwoko calo gin ma ki gwoko ma peya ki loko.
• Pe ki kwanyo gin mo keken — tic ni ki twero dwoko cen.
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Kwany kabedo me aryo:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml ki bi kwanyo.
• Kabedo me acel pe ki gudu.

Mede anyim?
